text: I started playing Marvel Rivals 2 years ago when it released. I am in one of the top ranks, Celestial but I am burnt out on the game right now and am taking a break from this game.

title: Ozias808.github.io
text:
About Me


Aloha! I’m Ozias Reyes and I am eighteen years old. I graduated from Kamehameha Schools Kapalama and am currently attending Chaminade University. I love playing video games and am trying my best through school life right now.

title: Games I like to play
text:
Overwatch
I used to play this game a bunch before Marvel Rivals came out but recently I find myself having fun in this game more than Marvel Rivals. The community is way less toxic and more friendly.

title: Games I like to play
text:
Mortal Kombat 1
I started playing this game with one of my friends around a year ago. We haven’t been playing a lot recently but it is still fun to lab out combos on characters. I play General Shao and Noob Saibot btw.

title: Games I like to play
text:
Roblox
This is just a game I play on my free time. Nothing that I keep playing, it’s just a nice game to turn my brain off too.

title: Games I like to play
text:
Umamusume Pretty Derby
I got into this fandom around my junior year in highschool and have been in this fandom ever since. I downloaded the game just this summer and have been enjoying racing these horse girls. Aston Machan best uma.

title: Games I like to play
text:
Resident Evil Requiem(9)
I just finished this game recently as this is a part of the resident evil franchise. This game was my introduction to the Resident Evil games and I hope to play the others eventually

title: Games I like to play
text:
Skate
This is another game that I jsut turn my brain off too. Nothing major about it, I just like to ride my skate board around the city.

title: Games I like to play
text:
Fortnite
I have played this game since I was in middle school but right now I am trying to get the pirate shop coin. I need that. It fuels me.

title: Games I like to play
text:
Expedition 33
Recently just finished this game and I can see why it won game of the year. It made me tear up in the first hour of playing, that’s how I know it was a good game.

title: Games I like to play
text:
Yu-Gi-Oh! Master Duel
This is a card game I play that I got into because of my older brother. He taught me the basics and now I play a Rescue-Ace/Diabel-Star/Snake-Eyes deck. Super fun!

title: Games I like to play
text:
Elden Ring
I finished this game a couple months ago and I am very glad I got to finish this master piece. I love souls like games so finally getting the money to but this game was well spent.

title: Games I like to play
text:
The Outlast Trials
My older brother got me into this game and I ended up playing the game more than him. I started watching guides and learning tips and tricks to get better. Haven’t played the game in a while so I might be a little washed.

title: Games I like to play
text:
Minecraft
Just another classic game I like to play to shut my brain off. I like to build houses even though I suck at it.
